response.sql: WITH category_totals AS (SELECT category, AVG(remaining) AS avg_remaining, SUM(amount - spent) AS total FROM budget WHERE amount > 75 GROUP BY category), overall AS (SELECT AVG(total) AS avg_total FROM category_totals) SELECT c.category, c.avg_remaining, c.total, c.total - o.avg_total AS above_average FROM category_totals AS c CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.avg_total IS NOT NULL AND c.total > o.avg_total
